services.name: Evening Paddle
services.desc: Online booking suggested Single Kayak - $32.50 Tandem Kayak - $65.00 About Come unwind on the water! Enjoy the peaceful nature of a leisurely paddle around Eagle Harbor and/or Rockaway Beach while observing avian and marine mammal life from a unique perspective. Advance booking required! 1.5 Come relax on the water!

services.name: Paddleboard Tour
services.desc: Online booking suggested $44.95 per paddleboard/person Minimum 2 participants per tour; please call if you'd like to book for one person and be put on an "awaiting paddling buddy" list to see if someone else books as well! About Enjoy the wonderful paddling destination of Eagle Harbor by day or evening. This is a great introduction to Bainbridge Island by stand up paddleboard. Experience the scenery and wildlife from a different perspective. Look for otters, osprey and migratory birds! No experience necessary and all gear is provided. Advance booking required! Please call us @ (206) Enjoy A Paddleboard Adventure for $44.95 Per Person

services.name: Full Moon Paddle
services.desc: Online booking suggested Single Kayak - $62.50 Tandem Kayak - $125.00 About Enjoy the wonderful paddling destination of Eagle Harbor by the evening light turned night. This is an interesting perspective of Bainbridge Island and one of the best ways to view the gorgeous Northwest sunsets. Experience the scenery and wildlife from a different perspective as the sun sets and the moon rises above the city of Seattle. No experience necessary and all kayaking gear is provided but you must furnish your own flashlight. Advance booking required! 2.0 Enjoy A Sunset and Full Moon Paddle

services.name: Perseid Meteor Shower
services.desc: Online booking required Tandem Kayak Only - $65.00pp About Enjoy the wonderful paddling destination of Rich Passage by the evening light turned night. This is an interesting perspective of Bainbridge Island and one of the best ways to view the Perseid Meteor Shower . Experience the scenery and wildlife from a different perspective as the sun sets and the stars stand out away from the city lights. Previous kayaking experience a plus ! All kayaking gear is provided but you must furnish your own flashlight. Advance booking required! 2 Enjoy a paddle under a meteor shower!

services.name: Blakely Harbor Paddle
services.desc: Online booking suggested Single Kayak - $89.99. Tandem Kayak - $179.98. About Explore the historic old mill pond and search the sheltered waters and shores for wildlife. This is beautiful quiet bay and naturalist’s dream! No experience necessary and all gear is provided. Advance booking required! Please call us @ (206) 842-1980 if you have a large group and need more than 6 boats. 2 $89.99 per Person

services.name: General Paddling Strokes
services.desc: Online booking suggested Single Kayak - $99.00 Tandem Kayak - $198.00 About We will cover the basics of kayaks, paddles, life jackets, and safety equipment, as well as teach you how to get in and out of the kayak, paddle efficiently, and the various strokes employed. Part of the time will be spent discussing theory on the beach, but most of the time will be spent on the water practicing the strokes, taking in the sights, and getting technique critique. Prerequisite: None 2 Great for Beginners! · $119 per Person · 2 Hour Lesson

services.name: Discover Scuba
services.desc: Online booking suggested Person - $99.99 must be 10 years of age or older About Dreaming of exploring the underwater environment of the Puget Sound (or somewhere more tropical) but don't know where to start, or if you'd even like SCUBA diving? Come experience the excitement and thrill of breathing underwater on SCUBA equipment in a safe, controlled environment! In this 2 hour class you will learn essential skills such as donning your SCUBA unit, clearing your mask, attaining neutral buoyancy and most importantly how to be safe and have a great time while diving within the confines of $99.99 per Person · Ages 10+

services.name: Harbor to Harbor Kayak Tour
services.desc: Online booking suggested Single Kayak - $119.99 Tandem Kayak - $239.98 About Join us as we paddle and view the great scenery of Eagle Harbor along the shoreline to Blakely Harbor, the site of the old Pt. Blakely mill. We will point out numerous historical sites unique to the Island and Blakely harbor while experiencing the beauty of Northwest wildlife. Advance booking required! Please call us @ (206) 842-1980 if you have a large group and need more than 6 boats. 4 Hours(dock to dock including briefings) These times may vary dependent on paddling $119.99 per person

services.name: Rescue and Re-Entry
services.desc: Online booking suggested Single Kayak - $99.00 About Come join us for this 2 Hour session in one of our harbors. This short course is designed to boost the confidence of the new paddler or rusty one, where we will teach, review, and fine-tune efficient sea kayak rescue and re-entry techniques. 2 $129 per Person · 2 Hour Lesson
